newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai stock off-floor trading trials smooth.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai stock off-floor trading trials smooth.

text.p: Trial off-floor trading on the Shanghai stock exchange has been smooth, paving the way for a large-scale adoption of the system in the short term, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.

In the past two months, the exchange has been using off-floor trading through computers networks with three major domestic securities houses -- Jiangsu Provincial Securities, Guangdong's Guangfa Securities and Shanghai-based China Guotai Securities, the newspaper said.
"Brokers who have traded on the exchange in this way agree that off-floor trading has the advantages of higher speed, larger capacity, lower cost and fewer errors," it said.
But the brokers have also proposed several technical improvements, the newspaper said. It gave no details.
